A selection from the gallery

Begin with what moves you.

Three Drums, One Heartbeat

Three drummers in orange, red, and blue laugh as they play together against a wall of scraped paint and splashes of color. Expressive painted wall art celebrating rhythm, joy, and music as community.

Explore in the gallery →

Vision Keeper

A sunburst eye glows above her golden halo while ankh earrings hang beneath. Bold splatter-style wall art about vision, intuition, and seeing what others miss.

Explore in the gallery →

Library of the Mind

Open books and glowing connected nodes rise from her hair like a network of ideas. Bold gold-and-black splatter art about knowledge, learning, and a mind that never stops building.

Explore in the gallery →

The Creator's Crown

A camera, light bulb, crown, paintbrushes, fountain pen, vinyl record, and piano keys burst from her hair like a crown made of tools. Bold splatter-style wall art that celebrates every kind of creator.

Explore in the gallery →

The Language Between Us

Generations reach toward a single glowing seed beneath the branches of an ancient tree, their faces and hands woven into one pattern. Cubist-style wall art about heritage, family, and the language we pass between us.

Explore in the gallery →

Radiant Stillness

A woman in prayer, her folded hands lit by rays of golden light breaking through angular shadow. A cubist meditation on faith, peace, and the quiet strength of stillness.

Explore in the gallery →
